title: YuelingsPack
description: This is the resource pack included in YuelingWorkshop modpack. It provides Chinese localization for mods such as bushier flowers, create things and misc, deeper and darker, even better nether, and more.
body:
这是悦灵工坊整合包自带的资源包。提供了 bushier flowers、create things and misc、deeper and darker、even better nether 等等模组的汉化。

This is the resource pack included in the Yueling Workshop modpack. It provides Chinese localization for mods such as bushier flowers, create things and misc, deeper and darker, even better nether, and more.


<details>
<summary>已汉化的模组列表</summary>

- bushier flowers
- create things and misc
- deeper and darker
- even better nether
- garnished
- luminous: world
- macaw's biomes o' plenty
- project vibrant journeys
- you died
</details>

> 有些模组的汉化可能不完全，欢迎提出建议。
>
> Some mods may not be fully localized. Please feel free to send us your suggestions.
